ios.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: BoltPocket accesses your local network when you use local models, MCP, SSH, websites, or project capabilities that you configured.
ios.NSCameraUsageDescription: Allow authorized websites and project H5 apps to use the camera, or take photos to attach to conversations.
ios.NSCalendarsUsageDescription: Allow BoltPocket to read and change calendars when you authorize an Agent calendar action.
ios.NSCalendarsFullAccessUsageDescription: Allow BoltPocket to read and change calendars when you authorize an Agent calendar action.
ios.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Allow authorized websites and project H5 apps to use the microphone.
ios.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: BoltPocket includes location support for authorized websites and project H5 apps. It does not request background location; access is limited to while you use the app.
ios.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Allow authorized websites and project H5 apps to access your location while in use.
ios.NSMotionUsageDescription: Allow BoltPocket to read device motion during an Agent sensor request you authorize, or in an authorized website or project H5 app.
ios.NSRemindersUsageDescription: Allow BoltPocket to read and change reminders when you authorize an Agent reminder action.
ios.NSRemindersFullAccessUsageDescription: Allow BoltPocket to read and change reminders when you authorize an Agent reminder action.
ios.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Allow photo selection for website uploads or conversation attachments.
